test_title: PYST 07: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Aishwarya starts from her office in north direction. She turns to her left then to her right and finally after walking some more, she turns to her left. In which direction is she facing now?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Aishwarya starts from her office in north direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/615528fdd335e8c9dc69203367fdbee5bb8274c69f37f49512a45a79f7a75c22.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f170742b2c83c3ff9286ea9bfb5b7a12f3a3c53dfaee8c71dea2b6ec09bdd1e.png] 

2) She turns to her left then to her right and finally after walking some more, she turns to her left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/969a5affe231afac2b90875c6094eed94a5c4b22949296666b3af41cfbf6c5de.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a7affa70506ac80708b09bc5c691a60135c1828539bb71c16d58694708c4129.png] 

Here, we can see that she is now facing West direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"West"**.
